key_insight: Hyperband-optimized XGBoost achieved the highest reported AF detection performance, with a peak F1 score of 96.95%.
clinical_relevance: Optimizing ECG-based AF detection models may support more reliable screening, but this study does not establish clinical readiness.
method: Compared Decision Tree, Random Forest, and XGBoost classifiers with recurrent, deep, and Siamese neural networks.
Tuned models using Genetic Algorithm, Hyperband, Optuna, and SMAC3.
Evaluated inter-patient and intra-patient splits under class imbalance.
evidence_signal: Experiments used PhysioNet ECG datasets with inter-patient and intra-patient evaluation; the abstract does not specify which split yielded the peak F1 score.
watch_item: The abstract does not report external clinical validation, so generalization to new patient populations remains uncertain.
paper_title: Enhancing Atrial Fibrillation Detection Through Hyperparameter Optimization
